name: Negative Glitch
description: The picture flips to its negative, flares in exposure, shakes and zooms out with mirrored edges and a smeared, desaturated analogue-signal look, cutting to the second clip at the peak. Recreation of the CapCut "Negative Glitch" transition. Drive `progress` from 0 to 1.

inputs.name: second
inputs.description: Incoming clip (same size as the first)

params.name: duration
params.description: Real transition length in seconds; sets the speed of the shake

params.name: animate
params.description: true (default) = the shake moves in real time over `duration`. false = like CapCut's export: the shake stays frozen at its t = 0 offset
